groups.distinction: Native nonexhaustive YAML Error preserves specific syntax/type/policy/include/validation reasons, optional actual source locations, native I/O cause and snippet context. DeserializeError export is native descriptive alias of same owner, not proof a second application error wrapper is useful.
groups.uses: Display renders default snippets; custom serde error necessarily formats an arbitrary Display value and stores redacted text, whereas explicit variants retain fields. Empty std::error::Error impl2233 does not provide source traversal to nested stored causes, so retaining native Error and direct access pattern matters; do not claim every dependency inner error automatically walks source().
groups.disposition: Keep concrete native deserialization error as source at actual application boundary, add meaningful recipe/path/stage context only where it prevents actual mix-up. No useful simplification from flattening all YAML reasons into String or cloning the entire native variant taxonomy in game modules. Source text/name fields are open parser metadata, not closed game vocabulary.
groups.acceptance: Actual recipes/config callers must be reviewed independently11; preserve YAML native error ownership and source/snippet/location limits, avoid branching on rendered prose. Native Error::custom text conversion is real serde adapter, not justification for early loss of an owned game cause. No parser execution or dependency error implementation change.

limits: Exact pinned registered ranges personally read for11; no other-lens source credit, source edits, tests/checks, native execution, clearance or implementation plan.
